notes.subject: i was was bilong i kamap holi
notes.rationale: מתקדשת i ritim 'em i mekim holi' — hitim rit bilong was was long Lo 15; KJV 'purified', YLT 'purifying herself'.

notes.subject: taim ol i slip pinis
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i needim klia taim bilong pasin; Hebrew participle מתקדשת i stap namel long stori tasol.

notes.subject: מטמאתה
notes.rationale: Ol tanim i tok 'uncleanness' bilong meri (Lo 15:19); dispela tok i skelim taim bilong sip — em i pinisim taim tumas bilong en.

translation: Na David i salim ol mesinja, ol i kisim ⟨em⟩; na em i kam long en, na em i slip wantaim em; na ⟨taim ol i slip pinis⟩ em i was was bilong i kamap holi, i rausim tumas bilong en; na em i go bek long haus bilong en.
